subject: Request: Warmstart credit top-up for EdgeWorks regional latency probe

Subject: Warmstart run — need temporary credits for regional latency probe

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the warmstart improvements look promising. We have a 72h regional latency probe scheduled for next week (PST window) to validate real-world p95 behavior with our traffic profile.

High-level ask: would Redwood be able to provision an ephemeral credit allowance for the run? Estimated usage: 120k tokens over 72 hours (spiky, ~1.2k qps bursts during a couple of windows). We want the test to exercise KV warmstarts and prefix caching.

I've attached our run schedule and a short capacity plan. If you need billing info or a PO path, loop in your finance team — procurement@edgeworks.ai is CC'd.

Goal: get the run on our side for Fri–Sun next week (June 4–6 window in our calendar, timezone overlap). Quick answers appreciated so we can lock the test harness.

Thanks,
Andrew Cole
Head of Platform
EdgeWorks AI

sofia@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0118

Andrew — quick technical checklist from our side to get valid p95 telemetry:
- Use model variant: redwood-v1-medium-quant (reproducible latency profile).
- Enable prefix KV caching and set TTL to 6h for your warm segments.
- Run a short 30m warmup at 30% of target QPS before the full soak to populate caches.
- If you plan to hit 1.2k qps bursts, route those through our dedicated zone in us-west to avoid cross-region tail latency.

I attached a one-page runbook (warmstart-capacity-plan.xlsx) with the exact sequence. If you want we can schedule a 30-min preflight to confirm the harness and hooks into tracing.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
